prompt: Sodium (2,8,1) gives one electron to chlorine. What does sodium become?
explanation: Sodium loses its one outer electron, so it has 11 protons and 10 electrons. That is a charge of +1, and the electrons fill 2,8, a complete outer shell (an octet).

prompt: Why does chlorine take an electron instead of giving its electrons away?

options.text: It has 1 outer electron, which is easy to lose
It has 7 outer electrons, so gaining 1 completes its octet
It has no outer electrons at all
Its outer shell is already complete

explanation: Chlorine is 2,8,7. Gaining one electron gives 2,8,8, a complete outer shell (an octet). Losing seven electrons would take much more.
